TARANTULA_GENERATOR_12 }} A '''Tarantula Minion''' is a {{Skill|Combat}} [[Minion]] that spawns {{MobSprite|Tarantula Spider}}s and collects {{Item|String}}, {{Item|Spider Eye}}s, and {{Item|Iron Ingot}}s. '''Tarantula Minion''' recipes, except '''Tarantula Minion XII''', are unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Spider Slayer V}}. '''Tarantula Minion XII''' recipe is unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Spider Slayer IX}}. A '''Tarantula Minion XII''' does not need {{CollectionLink|Spider Slayer IX}} to be placed down. Players get one free '''Tarantula Minion I''' by reaching {{CollectionLink|Spider Slayer V}}. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Ideal Layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Tarantula Minion|ideal=Air (minion)|border=Oak Fence}} === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|combat}} == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Trivia == * When giving the "{{red|I can't reach any }}" warning, it used to show as {{red|I can't reach any Cave Spiders!}}.
